request.subject: PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:SUBMARINE

layers.text: Turn it into a goblin diving barrel submarine: the boat becomes one big fat closed wooden barrel lying on its side, of the same grey-tan planks with tin hoops and a riveted tin patch, with one round glass porthole and a crooked tin periscope pipe on top; remove the mast and the sail; keep the lime green goblin peeking out of a hatch window; one hazard yellow patch. No water. Keep the size, thick black outline and art style the same, on a transparent background.
